about.title: A Story of Success & Continuous Development
about.subtitle: About Our Factory
about.p1: Our factory started with a clear vision: to provide the finest quality of agricultural crops and natural products of peanuts, sesame, and their derivatives. Over the years, we have invested in state-of-the-art electronic sorting equipment and fully automated lines to guarantee superior quality matching the highest international standards.
about.p2: We care about every single grain that enters our factory, from crop receipt from partner farms, through advanced optical sorting, to safe packaging to reach our clients across various countries of the world.

stages.title: Journey of the Grain: Production Stages
stages.subtitle: How do we make quality?
stages.stage1_desc: We carefully select crops from the best natural farms and inspect them immediately upon arrival.
stages.stage2_desc: Utilizing advanced electronic optical sorters to separate grains by size and color with high precision.
stages.stage3_desc: Completely cleaning the crop from dust, shells, and foreign objects automatically.
stages.stage4_desc: An additional stage of meticulous visual inspection by the quality team to ensure zero defects.
stages.stage5_desc: Gentle roasting using modern ovens, and processing 100% pure peanut butter and sesame tahini.
stages.stage6_desc: Fully automated, tightly sealed packaging under strict hygienic conditions to preserve taste and nutrition.
stages.stage7_desc: Preparing shipments according to international shipping standards and delivering locally and globally.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our products, manufacturing, and sales
faq.q1: Are peanut butter and tahini products 100% natural?
faq.a1: Yes, all our peanut butter, tahini, and sesame oil products are 100% natural, completely free from hydrogenated oils, added sugar, and preservatives.
faq.q2: How are peanuts sorted and cleaned from impurities?
faq.a2: We use the latest electronic sorting machines (laser optical sorting) which inspect every single grain and reject damaged grains or impurities automatically with extreme accuracy, followed by manual check.
faq.q3: Does the factory supply commercial quantities for other manufacturers?
faq.a3: Yes, we have a specialized division for industrial orders (like confectionery factories and bakeries) providing large scale bulk packaging (sacks and buckets) according to required specifications.
faq.q4: What products does the factory manufacture?
faq.a4: We manufacture and package a variety of natural products, including roasted peanuts, various types of peanut butter, various types of tahini, natural sesame, as well as other products upon request.
faq.q5: How can I order products or ask about prices?
faq.a5: You can order products directly through the website by clicking 'Order Now' on the product page, filling the contact form, or contacting us directly via WhatsApp for an immediate response.
